title: The Firestorm Over a Rape Allegation at Cornell

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的瑞秋·艾布拉姆斯，欢迎收听《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: An alleged sexual assault at Cornell has gripped the country and ignited a national debate over consent and how universities respond to allegations of rape.
sentences.zh: 康奈尔大学发生的一起涉嫌性侵事件震惊了全国，并引发了关于“同意”以及大学应如何应对强奸指控的全国性辩论。

sentences.en: And now, documents reviewed by The New York Times help to explain what happened at the university and why the district attorney initially decided not to pursue any charges
sentences.zh: 目前，《纽约时报》审阅的文件有助于解释这所大学里究竟发生了什么，以及为什么地区检察官最初决定不对

sentences.en: against the men at the center of the allegations.
sentences.zh: 指控核心的几名男子提起任何诉讼。

sentences.en: And so today, Debra Kamen explains what we know about what happened at Cornell
sentences.zh: 因此，今天黛布拉·卡门将为我们解读关于康奈尔大学事件的已知信息，

sentences.en: and whether the systems in place are equipped to handle these sorts of complicated cases.
sentences.zh: 以及现有的制度是否有能力处理这类复杂的案件。

sentences.en: It's Friday, October 2nd.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月2日，星期五。

sentences.en: Debra Kamen, welcome to The Daily.
sentences.zh: 黛布拉·卡门，欢迎来到《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: So, Debra, all week there's been this news building and building about a case out of Cornell.
sentences.zh: 黛布拉，整个星期以来，关于康奈尔大学这起案件的新闻一直在不断发酵。

sentences.en: A woman has alleged that multiple men raped her at a frat party.
sentences.zh: 一名女性指控多名男子在一次兄弟会派对上强奸了她。

sentences.en: And I just want to tell listeners that this conversation is going to get graphic.
sentences.zh: 我需要先提醒听众，接下来的谈话内容可能会比较露骨。

sentences.en: It could be upsetting to some people.
sentences.zh: 可能会让一些人感到不适。

sentences.en: So just to start, walk us through what happened to cause what has become this huge national story.
sentences.zh: 那么，首先请为我们梳理一下这起演变成全国性重大新闻的事件经过。

sentences.en: You know, Rachel, I've been covering sexual assault and sexual harassment for many years.
sentences.zh: 瑞秋，我报道性侵和性骚扰案件已经很多年了。

sentences.en: And I can't recall a story that has really gripped the national conversation like this one.
sentences.zh: 我不记得还有哪起案件能像这起一样，如此深刻地引发全国性的讨论。

sentences.en: And before Wednesday, what we knew about this story was pretty bare bones.
sentences.zh: 在周三之前，我们对这起事件的了解还非常有限。

sentences.en: We knew that there was a woman.
sentences.zh: 我们只知道有一名女性。

sentences.en: She's just going by Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 她以“简·多伊”（Jane Doe）的化名行事。

sentences.en: And she says in October 2024, she was raped at a frat house by several men.
sentences.zh: 她说在2024年10月，她在一家兄弟会宿舍被几名男子强奸了。

sentences.en: She filed a complaint with the school and campus police, and the DA declined to prosecute.
sentences.zh: 她向学校和校园警察提交了投诉，但地区检察官拒绝起诉。

sentences.en: The school did decide to expel a few of the men.
sentences.zh: 学校确实决定开除其中几名男子。

sentences.en: Some had to write essays.
sentences.zh: 有些人被要求写检讨书。

sentences.en: But the case really fell out of view.
sentences.zh: 但此案随后便淡出了人们的视野。

sentences.en: There was no criminal case.
sentences.zh: 没有进行刑事立案。

sentences.en: And then in September, Jane Doe filed a civil lawsuit against seven men as well as a number of additional defendants.
sentences.zh: 接着在9月，简·多伊对七名男子以及其他多名被告提起了民事诉讼。

sentences.en: Those are the fraternity, the sorority, and even the bar that gave her alcohol that night.
sentences.zh: 被告包括兄弟会、姐妹会，甚至还有那天晚上为她提供酒精的酒吧。

sentences.en: Some of the men have denied the charges, but others haven't said anything in public yet.
sentences.zh: 其中一些男子否认了指控，但其他人尚未公开表态。

sentences.en: And then all of a sudden, the Cornell Sun, which is the paper at her school, made this controversial decision.
sentences.zh: 随后，她所在学校的校报《康奈尔太阳报》做出了一个极具争议的决定。

sentences.en: They published the names of the seven men on their front page.
sentences.zh: 他们在头版刊登了这七名男子的名字。

sentences.en: And remember, these guys have not been charged with a crime yet.
sentences.zh: 请记住，这些人当时尚未受到任何刑事指控。

sentences.en: And shortly after they published those names, there was a massive uproar.
sentences.zh: 在名单公布后不久，舆论一片哗然。

sentences.en: And the DA on Monday, in the wake of all of this, decided to reopen the criminal case.
sentences.zh: 周一，在这一背景下，地区检察官决定重启刑事调查。

sentences.en: So immediately, there were so many questions about what happened here.
sentences.zh: 因此，人们立刻对这里发生的事情提出了许多疑问。

sentences.en: Did Cornell fail somewhere?
sentences.zh: 康奈尔大学在某些环节失职了吗？

sentences.en: And most importantly, was there a crime?
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，这是否构成犯罪？

sentences.en: What exactly compelled the DA to reopen the case, if we know?
sentences.zh: 如果已知的话，究竟是什么促使地区检察官重启案件？

sentences.en: Like, was there new information presented that maybe he didn't have two years ago?
sentences.zh: 比如，是否出现了他两年前没有掌握的新信息？

sentences.en: The DA was under a lot of pressure because the lawsuit has a lot of inflammatory allegations.
sentences.zh: 地区检察官承受了很大压力，因为诉讼中包含许多煽动性的指控。

sentences.en: There's a Snapchat thread in the lawsuit, and some of the men involved in the incident announced to the chat, and they're using really crude language.
sentences.zh: 诉讼中提到了一段Snapchat聊天记录，涉案的一些男子在群聊中宣布了此事，并使用了非常粗俗的语言。

sentences.en: I'm not going to repeat it here.
sentences.zh: 我在这里就不重复了。

sentences.en: But essentially, they're saying there's a woman upstairs, and it's inviting them up to join, kind of like they're saying the shop is open.
sentences.zh: 但本质上，他们是在说楼上有个女人，邀请大家上去加入，就像在说“店门已开”一样。

sentences.en: And the lawsuit alleges things like she was pressured to take drugs and alcohol, and a lot of things that they just really raise questions as to whether or not she was raped.
sentences.zh: 诉讼还指控她被迫服用药物和饮酒，很多细节都让人质疑她是否真的遭到了强奸。

sentences.en: And taken on its face, the allegations, at the very least, they beg the question, was this properly investigated, and was something missed?
sentences.zh: 从表面上看，这些指控至少引发了一个问题：调查是否得当？是否有遗漏之处？

sentences.en: By reopening this case, is the DA effectively saying, these details are all new to me?
sentences.zh: 地区检察官重启此案，是否实际上是在说：这些细节对我来说都是新的？

sentences.en: Like, what did he actually say about that decision?
sentences.zh: 他本人对这个决定是怎么说的？

sentences.en: The DA has said two things that are very interesting.
sentences.zh: 地区检察官说了两点非常有趣的内容。

sentences.en: The first is that he has noted that there are key pieces of evidence that were initially provided by Jane Doe in her interviews with Cornell after the alleged rape that he was not provided,
sentences.zh: 第一，他指出在涉嫌强奸案发生后，简·多伊在接受康奈尔大学采访时提供了一些关键证据，而这些证据最初并没有移交给他，

sentences.en: that may potentially change the story of what happened here.
sentences.zh: 这些证据可能会改变对事件经过的描述。

sentences.en: He has also conceded that her sworn statement in 2024, it is different than what she's saying in the lawsuit, which was filed in 2026.
sentences.zh: 他也承认，她在2024年所做的宣誓陈述，与她在2026年提起的诉讼中所述内容存在差异。

sentences.en: And he's signaling that that doesn't mean that her story has changed.
sentences.zh: 但他暗示，这并不意味着她的说法变了。

sentences.en: It means that a victim's understanding of something as traumatic as a sexual assault can change over time, and that this may merit a second look at this point.
sentences.zh: 这意味着受害者对性侵这种创伤性事件的理解可能会随时间而改变，因此现在有必要重新审视此案。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So he's basically acknowledging that this woman's perception of the events in question could be enough justification for them to reexamine things.
sentences.zh: 所以他基本上是在承认，这名女性对相关事件的认知变化，足以成为他们重新调查的理由。

sentences.en: Yes, precisely.
sentences.zh: 是的，正是如此。

sentences.en: And that's one of the most interesting things about this case, and I really think why it has captured so much national attention.
sentences.zh: 这也是此案最耐人寻味的地方，我认为这也是它引起全国如此多关注的原因。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the reaction has been really fierce very quickly.
sentences.zh: 而且舆论反应非常激烈，且迅速。

sentences.en: The reaction has been fierce.
sentences.zh: 反应确实很激烈。

sentences.en: They said she shouldn't have been drinking, and that wouldn't have happened to her.
sentences.zh: 有人说她本不该喝酒，那样就不会发生这种事了。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: Literally.
sentences.zh: 简直是胡说八道。

sentences.en: What the f*** is wrong with y'all?
sentences.zh: 你们这些人到底有什么毛病？

sentences.en: You had people saying that she was definitely raped.
sentences.zh: 也有人说她绝对是被强奸了。

sentences.en: Cornell, you not only failed a student that was drugged and s*** assaulted by seven Cornell students, but you also failed every other woman on campus.
sentences.zh: 康奈尔大学，你们不仅辜负了一名被七名康奈尔学生下药并性侵的学生，也辜负了校园里的每一位女性。

sentences.en: Denied justice.
sentences.zh: 正义被拒绝了。

sentences.en: This is an abomination.
sentences.zh: 这简直是令人发指。

sentences.en: The victim had to attend the school with the same people who raped her.
sentences.zh: 受害者不得不和强奸她的人在同一所学校上学。

sentences.en: I hope you have some good explanations when the time comes to explain why you closed this case early.
sentences.zh: 我希望到时候你们能给出合理的解释，说明为什么当初草草结案。

sentences.en: And then you have people saying that she is a liar who changed her story, that she made an accusation because she was ashamed.
sentences.zh: 还有人说她是骗子，改口供是因为感到羞耻。

sentences.en: What she's saying now in her civil suit is completely different from what she wrote in a very detailed statement to us.
sentences.zh: 她现在在民事诉讼中的说法，与她当初写给我们的那份详尽陈述完全不同。

sentences.en: So many people have so many takes and are examining the story on every angle.
sentences.zh: 太多人有太多看法，正从各个角度审视这个故事。

sentences.en: What happened was legal.
sentences.zh: 发生的事情是合法的。

sentences.en: Even within the woman's own account, she consents over and over, and when she revokes consent, the action stops.
sentences.zh: 即使在当事人自己的陈述中，她也多次表示同意，而当她撤回同意时，行为就停止了。

sentences.en: And so much of it is coming from people who really barely even know the facts of the case.
sentences.zh: 而且很多言论来自那些几乎不了解案情的人。

sentences.en: But there are these key questions that were not answered when this lawsuit was filed.
sentences.zh: 但在诉讼提起时，确实有一些关键问题没有得到解答。

sentences.en: We didn't know what happened in the days between when she says she was raped and when she went to campus police.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道在她自称被强奸的那几天到她去报警之间发生了什么。

sentences.en: We didn't know what happened between going to campus police and going to the DA.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道她去校园警察局和去地区检察官办公室之间发生了什么。

sentences.en: We didn't know why charges weren't filed and what information was handed off.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道为什么没有提起诉讼，也不知道移交了哪些信息。

sentences.en: And in all those questions, it was just filled, like so many things are,
sentences.zh: 所有这些疑问，就像许多事情一样，被填满了，

sentences.en: with hot takes and commentary on Twitter and people taking sides without having a lot of information about any of the people involved in this story.
sentences.zh: 充斥着推特上的激烈言论和评论，人们在对涉案人员一无所知的情况下就开始站队。

sentences.en: Until Wednesday, when here at the New York Times, we were able to review over 1,000 pages of documents and transcripts showing details, immense details,
sentences.zh: 直到周三，我们《纽约时报》审阅了超过1000页的文件和笔录，其中展示了大量细节，极其详尽的细节，

sentences.en: from the school's internal investigation into this alleged assault.
sentences.zh: 来自学校对这起涉嫌性侵案的内部调查。

sentences.en: And suddenly, we had answers to almost all of those questions.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，我们几乎找到了所有问题的答案。

sentences.en: So, Debra, tell us what you learned from all of these documents.
sentences.zh: 那么，黛布拉，告诉我们你从这些文件中了解到了什么。

sentences.en: What I learned, and what I think all the reporters who spent all of Wednesday night into Thursday morning combing through these hundreds of pages,
sentences.zh: 我所了解到的，以及我认为所有从周三晚一直忙到周四早晨梳理这些数百页文件的记者们所了解到的，

sentences.en: is they give you a lot more insight into not just what happened that night in October at Cornell, but also how Jane Doe's feelings about what happened changed over time.
sentences.zh: 是这些文件不仅让我们深入了解了10月那个晚上在康奈尔大学发生了什么，还揭示了简·多伊对所发生之事的感受是如何随时间变化的。

sentences.en: We have interviews with Jane Doe, and we also have interviews with people who are around her, her two roommates, her big sister, her sorority,
sentences.zh: 我们有对简·多伊的采访，也有对她身边人的采访，包括她的两名室友、她的“大姐”、她的姐妹会成员，

sentences.en: and also in interviews with six of the seven men who were accused.
sentences.zh: 以及对七名被指控男子中六人的采访。

sentences.en: You take all these different angles and all these different conversations about the same event together,
sentences.zh: 当你把所有这些关于同一事件的不同视角和谈话结合在一起时，

sentences.en: and it paints a picture of someone who took time to process an event and had to come to terms with her own understanding of what it was.
sentences.zh: 它描绘出了一个人的形象：她花时间去消化这一事件，并不得不接受自己对所发生之事的理解。

sentences.en: I want to talk about how her feelings changed and how she processed this.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈她的感受是如何变化的，以及她是如何消化这些经历的。

sentences.en: But first, can you just take us back to the day that all of this allegedly occurred?
sentences.zh: 但首先，你能带我们回到据称这一切发生的那一天吗？

sentences.en: Like, what happened according to the materials that you reviewed?
sentences.zh: 根据你审阅的材料，当时发生了什么？

sentences.en: Yeah, so according to these documents, on October 19th, 2024, this woman, Jane Doe, she had a really bad day.
sentences.zh: 好的，根据这些文件，2024年10月19日，这名女性简·多伊度过了非常糟糕的一天。

sentences.en: She was actually robbed in the morning.
sentences.zh: 她早上被抢劫了。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And she filed a police report.
sentences.zh: 她报了警。

sentences.en: She lost her wallet.
sentences.zh: 她丢了钱包。

sentences.en: She didn't have her ID.
sentences.zh: 她没有身份证件。

sentences.en: That night, Jane Doe was supposed to be the sober monitor with her sorority.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，简·多伊本应担任姐妹会的清醒监督员。

sentences.en: It's a handful of students who stay sober and keep track of all the other students to make sure they're okay when they're drinking.
sentences.zh: 这通常由几名学生担任，她们保持清醒，负责照看其他学生，确保她们喝酒时安全。

sentences.en: Get them safe, all that stuff.
sentences.zh: 确保她们安全回家之类的。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.zh: 所以她没有履行清醒监督员的职责。

sentences.en: And then later in the day, around dinner time, she decides to go out.
sentences.zh: 但后来在晚餐时间，她决定出门。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.

sentences.zh: 她虽然未成年，但还是设法喝了酒。

sentences.en: And late in the evening, early in the morning of October 20th, she ends up at this frat house.
sentences.zh: 深夜，也就是10月20日凌晨，她最终来到了这家兄弟会宿舍。

sentences.en: And she says in her interview with investigators, she's very forthright.
sentences.zh: 她在接受调查人员采访时说，她非常坦率。

sentences.en: There was a guy there she wanted to see.
sentences.zh: 那里有个她想见的男生。

sentences.en: She liked him.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢他。

sentences.zh: 她是去找他的。

sentences.en: And they start having sex, which is consensual.
sentences.zh: 他们开始发生性关系，这是双方自愿的。

sentences.en: And eventually someone else joins in.
sentences.zh: 后来有人加入了进来。

sentences.en: And at that point, it is, according to the investigation, also consensual.
sentences.zh: 根据调查，在那一刻，这依然是自愿的。

sentences.en: But she says she is under the influence of a lot of alcohol.
sentences.zh: 但她说她当时处于醉酒状态。

sentences.en: And she talks about how there's a lot of drugs going around.
sentences.zh: 她谈到当时有很多毒品在流传。

sentences.en: There's ketamine being used as well.
sentences.zh: 还有氯胺酮（K粉）的使用。

sentences.zh: 氯胺酮是一种非常强效的物质。

sentences.en: And as she tells her story, she explains to investigators that there comes to be a point where she's no longer really clear on whether or not she's in control.
sentences.zh: 在讲述自己的故事时，她向调查人员解释说，到了某个时刻，她已经不清楚自己是否还能掌控局面了。

sentences.en: And other men come into the room.
sentences.zh: 随后又有其他男子进入房间。

sentences.en: The documents show that she told school administrators that at this point, she didn't want to be there.
sentences.zh: 文件显示，她告诉学校管理人员，在那一刻，她不想待在那里。

sentences.en: At one point, she even went under the covers.
sentences.zh: 有一次，她甚至躲进了被子里。

sentences.en: There was one line that I found particularly striking that I read, where she noted that because she felt uncomfortable, she took more ketamine because she wanted to numb herself
sentences.zh: 我读到的一行文字特别令我震惊，她提到因为感到不舒服，她又吸食了更多氯胺酮，因为她想让自己麻木，

sentences.en: from the situation that she felt she was stuck in.
sentences.zh: 逃避她感到被困住的处境。

sentences.en: So at that point, she says she's really too intoxicated to consent.
sentences.zh: 所以在那一刻，她说她已经醉到无法同意了。

sentences.en: She's also too intoxicated to know that she should say no to becoming more intoxicated.
sentences.zh: 她也醉到不知道自己应该拒绝继续摄入更多酒精或药物。

sentences.zh: 她说她被喂了更多毒品。

sentences.zh: 她被灌了更多酒。

sentences.zh: 她在文件中说，这可能是她一生中最醉的一次。

sentences.zh: 10月20日早上11点左右，简·多伊的室友注意到她回家了。

sentences.en: And Jane Doe's testimony corroborates this.
sentences.zh: 简·多伊的证词证实了这一点。

sentences.en: We should say, Debra, both you and I have done a lot of reporting on sexual assault and misconduct for the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我们应该说，黛布拉（Debra），你和我都在为《纽约时报》做过大量关于性侵犯和不当行为的报道。

sentences.en: And I think two things are broadly understood to be true.
sentences.zh: 我认为有两件事被广泛认为是事实。

sentences.en: And those are, number one, victims of sexual assault, they often have a shifting understanding of what happened to them over time.
sentences.zh: 第一，性侵犯的受害者，他们对所发生之事的理解往往会随着时间的推移而改变。

sentences.en: Could be weeks, could be months.

sentences.en: And obviously, what we know and what we can talk about on the show comes strictly from these documents that you and our colleagues have reported on.

sentences.en: And particularly in many other cases that I've reported on, that my colleagues have reported on, when there's drugs and alcohol

sentences.en: So when you make an allegation of rape or sexual assault on a college campus, it kicks off this process called Title IX, which is the formal process on university campuses
sentences.zh: 所以，当你在一所大学校园里提出强奸或性侵犯指控时，它会启动一个名为“第九条”（Title IX）的程序，这是大学校园里

sentences.en: for investigating allegations like this.
sentences.zh: 调查此类指控的正式程序。

sentences.en: So Jane Doe went to campus police on November 14th, and according to these documents that we reviewed, she spoke for hours with an officer,
sentences.zh: 简·多伊在11月14日去了校园警察局，根据我们审查的这些文件，她与一名警官谈了几个小时，

sentences.en: and it ends up being almost 120 pages of a transcript of her telling in graphic detail her understanding of what happened in those critical hours and how she felt that she was not
sentences.zh: 最终形成了近120页的笔录，详细描述了她对那些关键时刻所发生之事的理解，以及她如何感到自己并非

sentences.en: fully consensual to the events.
sentences.zh: 完全自愿参与这些事件。

sentences.en: And the really key point that she said to them that is in this transcript that we've reviewed is she said, I can say with 100% confidence that I was raped.
sentences.zh: 她在我们审查的这份笔录中对他们说的最关键的一点是，她说：“我可以百分之百肯定地说，我被强奸了。”

sentences.en: And this is hours and hours of testimony, but those hours and hours of testimony are not what went to the DA.
sentences.zh: 这是长达数小时的证词，但这些数小时的证词并没有提交给地方检察官。

sentences.en: Instead, after giving all of those hours of testimony, that statement was condensed into a six-page document.
sentences.zh: 相反，在提供了所有这些小时的证词后，那份陈述被压缩成了一份六页的文件。

sentences.en: It was written in Jane Doe's voice, but she didn't write it.
sentences.zh: 它是以简·多伊的口吻写的，但不是她写的。

sentences.en: This is just the process.
sentences.zh: 这只是程序。

sentences.en: It's standard.
sentences.zh: 这是标准的。

sentences.en: They said, okay, let's condense down what you said.
sentences.zh: 他们说：“好吧，让我们把你说的内容压缩一下。”

sentences.en: She made lots of handwritten notes.
sentences.zh: 她做了很多手写笔记。

sentences.en: She reviewed it.
sentences.zh: 她审阅了它。

sentences.en: She came back the next day.
sentences.zh: 她第二天又回来了。

sentences.en: And at the very end, she signed the statement and said, okay, I'm good with this.
sentences.zh: 最后，她签署了这份声明并说：“好吧，我没问题。”

sentences.en: And that's what went to the DA.
sentences.zh: 这就是提交给地方检察官的内容。

sentences.en: But now, since we have the original interview, we can see the difference.
sentences.zh: 但现在，既然我们有了最初的采访记录，我们就能看出区别。

sentences.en: And key points were left out, including that critical statement, I can say with 100% confidence I was raped.
sentences.zh: 关键点被遗漏了，包括那句关键的陈述：“我可以百分之百肯定地说，我被强奸了。”

sentences.en: The DA says he never saw that.
sentences.zh: 地方检察官说他从未见过那句话。

sentences.en: So how did those six pages describe what she had told investigators?
sentences.zh: 那么那六页纸是如何描述她告诉调查人员的内容的呢？

sentences.en: The six pages were really focused on the fact that she went to this party.
sentences.zh: 这六页纸确实集中在她是去参加了这个派对的事实上。

sentences.en: She drank a lot.
sentences.zh: 她喝了很多酒。

sentences.en: She had sex with several men.
sentences.zh: 她与几名男子发生了性关系。

sentences.en: There were moments when she asked them to stop.
sentences.zh: 有几次她要求他们停下来。

sentences.en: And they did stop temporarily.
sentences.zh: 他们确实暂时停了下来。

sentences.en: And then they proceeded.
sentences.zh: 然后他们又继续了。

sentences.en: The six pages are also really focused on how the events of the night would line up with the New York state law about what the definition of rape is.
sentences.zh: 这六页纸还非常关注当晚发生的事件如何与纽约州关于强奸定义的法律相吻合。

sentences.en: And this is a very tricky law that says if you are voluntarily taking drugs and alcohol, you have to be at a very specific bar of intoxication to not be able to consent.
sentences.zh: 这是一条非常棘手的法律，它规定如果你是自愿摄入毒品和酒精，你必须达到一个非常具体的醉酒程度，才会被认定为无法表示同意。

sentences.en: And it was because of this six-page document, according to the DA, that they initially decided there simply was not grounds for any levying of criminal charges.
sentences.zh: 据地方检察官称，正是因为这份六页的文件，他们最初决定根本没有理由提起刑事指控。

sentences.en: Did the six pages include anything about how she felt about what had happened to her?
sentences.zh: 这六页内容里是否包含她对自己所遭遇之事的感受？

sentences.en: They do.
sentences.zh: 有的。

sentences.en: There are definitely lines in there that explain that she was conflicted about what happened.
sentences.zh: 里面确实有一些话解释了她对所发生的事情感到矛盾。

sentences.en: She was uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 她感到不舒服。

sentences.en: She tells them at one point that she was at an intoxication level of 8 out of 10.
sentences.zh: 她在某一点上告诉他们，她的醉酒程度是10分里的8分。

sentences.en: That's in the document.
sentences.zh: 这在文件中都有记录。

sentences.en: They're just not as explicit as her longer 120-page interview.
sentences.zh: 只是没有她在长达120页的访谈中说得那么明确。

sentences.en: I mean, it seems to me that the six pages might not have included the most inflammatory explicit language, that bit about I'm 100% certain that I was raped.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在我看来，这六页文件可能没有包含最具煽动性的明确语言，比如那句“我百分之百确定我被强奸了”。

sentences.en: But there's enough in there that indicate that she believed something non-consensual had happened.
sentences.zh: 但里面有足够的内容表明，她认为发生了一些违背她意愿的事情。

sentences.en: That's why she went to the police to begin with.
sentences.zh: 这就是她最初去报警的原因。

sentences.en: And so I'm curious, you've covered this area before.
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，你以前报道过这个领域。

sentences.en: You are familiar with New York's law.
sentences.zh: 你很熟悉纽约州的法律。

sentences.en: When you read what was in those six pages, what did you make of the decision by the DA at the time not to prosecute?
sentences.zh: 当你读到那六页纸的内容时，你对当时地方检察官不予起诉的决定有何看法？

sentences.en: So remember, the bar for prosecuting rape and bringing criminal charges is extremely high.
sentences.zh: 记住，起诉强奸罪和提起刑事指控的门槛极高。

sentences.en: So yes, Rachel, you are right.
sentences.zh: 所以是的，瑞秋，你是对的。

sentences.en: It does feel in these six pages that they were clear that this was a woman who believed she had had something non-consensual happen to her body.
sentences.zh: 在这六页纸中，他们确实清楚地表明，这是一位认为自己的身体遭受了违背意愿之事对待的女性。

sentences.en: But that is not the same as there being enough evidence based on these six pages that charges could be brought and then successfully prosecuted.
sentences.zh: 但这并不等同于有足够的证据基于这六页纸提起指控并成功定罪。

sentences.en: I see.
sentences.zh: 我明白了。

sentences.en: There is a huge gap in a woman thinking she is raped.
sentences.zh: 女性认为自己被强奸与法律认定之间存在巨大的鸿沟。

sentences.en: Even if the DA is confident that she might be right, it doesn't mean she can prove it in a court of law.
sentences.zh: 即使地方检察官相信她可能是对的，也不代表她能在法庭上证明这一点。

sentences.en: Do we know whether anybody involved in sort of the school side investigation, campus police or anybody from Title IX, make the case to the DA like, hey, wait, we have way more
sentences.zh: 我们是否知道参与学校方面调查的人员，比如校园警察或第九条教育修正案的任何人，是否曾向地方检察官陈述过，嘿，等等，我们有更多

sentences.en: information.
sentences.zh: 信息。

sentences.en: She told us all these other things.
sentences.zh: 她告诉了我们所有这些其他事情。

sentences.en: Was there any further effort made to get the DA to reconsider or to pursue anything?
sentences.zh: 是否有进一步的努力促使地方检察官重新考虑或采取任何行动？

sentences.en: So that's one of the questions that we still don't know, that we're continuing to try to report out.
sentences.zh: 这是我们仍然不知道的问题之一，我们正在继续努力调查。

sentences.en: But we do know that after these six pages went to the DA, she filed a complaint and the Title IX investigation at Cornell continued.
sentences.zh: 但我们确实知道，在这六页文件提交给地方检察官后，她提出了投诉，康奈尔大学的第九条调查仍在继续。

sentences.en: And in it, the investigators did actually interview six of the seven men accused.
sentences.zh: 在调查中，调查人员确实采访了七名被指控男性中的六人。

sentences.en: We don't know why one of them wasn't interviewed, but we have the transcripts from their interviews as well.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道为什么其中一人没有被采访，但我们也拿到了他们采访的笔录。

sentences.en: And those are also very, very striking.
sentences.zh: 那些笔录也非常、非常引人注目。

sentences.en: What did they say, these men?
sentences.zh: 这些人说了什么？

sentences.en: So four of the men acknowledged they had had sexual contact with this Jane Doe, but they did say in their interviews that all of the sexual contact was consensual.
sentences.zh: 四名男子承认他们与这位简·多伊有过性接触，但他们在采访中确实表示，所有的性接触都是双方自愿的。

sentences.en: One said he asked for her consent before he had a threesome with her.
sentences.zh: 其中一人说，在与她进行三人性行为之前，他征求了她的同意。

sentences.en: And he told investigators that he told her, if you're uncomfortable with any of this, you don't want to do this, that's fine.
sentences.zh: 他告诉调查人员，他曾对她说，如果你对这一切感到不舒服，不想做，那没关系。

sentences.en: And he says, per his investigation, that Jane Doe replied that we're all consenting adults here.
sentences.zh: 他说，根据他的调查，简·多伊回答说我们在这里都是自愿的成年人。

sentences.en: The others said that they didn't have sex at all.
sentences.zh: 其他人则表示他们根本没有发生性关系。

sentences.en: They denied it.
sentences.zh: 他们否认了。

sentences.en: But one of the men actually said that he was a victim of sexual misconduct because he was also very drunk.
sentences.zh: 但其中一名男子实际上说，他也是性不端行为的受害者，因为他也喝得非常醉。

sentences.en: He points out that Jane Doe gave him oral sex and he perhaps, according to the same standard she's applying, also was not able to consent at that point.
sentences.zh: 他指出简·多伊对他进行了口交，按照她所适用的同一标准，他当时可能也无法表示同意。

sentences.en: So all of their accounts were different.
sentences.zh: 所以他们的说法各不相同。

sentences.en: Most of them don't line up with Jane Doe's version of events.
sentences.zh: 他们大多数人的说法与简·多伊的事件版本不符。

sentences.en: But what was most striking to me was not the very specific questions these guys were asked.
sentences.zh: 但最让我震惊的不是这些家伙被问到的具体问题。

sentences.en: It was the questions that they weren't asked.
sentences.zh: 而是他们没有被问到的问题。

sentences.en: They were not asked point blank, did she consent?
sentences.zh: 他们没有被直接问到：她同意了吗？

sentences.en: Did you feel that she was too intoxicated to proceed?
sentences.zh: 你是否觉得她醉得太厉害而无法继续？

sentences.en: The question is alluded to and it's mentioned, but these are not police interrogations.
sentences.zh: 问题被提及了，但这些不是警察审讯。

sentences.en: And the Title IX process is not the same as a criminal justice process.
sentences.zh: 第九条程序与刑事司法程序不同。

sentences.en: It is supposed to run next to it, alongside it, and be helpful.
sentences.zh: 它本应与刑事程序并行，起到辅助作用。

sentences.en: And it's meant to be an internal investigation for the campus.
sentences.zh: 它旨在成为校园内部的调查。

sentences.en: The people running it, they're administrators, they're people who work for the school.
sentences.zh: 负责运作的人是行政人员，是为学校工作的人。

sentences.en: They have some training, but these are not trained law enforcement officers.
sentences.zh: 他们受过一些培训，但他们不是训练有素的执法人员。

sentences.en: And these are not people with years and years of deep experience with sexual assault and sexual trauma.
sentences.zh: 他们也不是在性侵犯和性创伤方面拥有多年深厚经验的人。

sentences.en: You can see in the documents that these are people who were coming in to be helpful, but they have full-time jobs.
sentences.zh: 你可以从文件中看出，这些人是来帮忙的，但他们有全职工作。

sentences.en: One of the people involved in Title IX, you can see in the transcript, was driving while he was doing the interview.
sentences.zh: 其中一名参与第九条调查的人，你可以从笔录中看到，他在进行采访时正在开车。

sentences.en: He was multitasking.
sentences.zh: 他在一心多用。

sentences.en: And there are accusations now that things might have been missed in this process because of these factors.
sentences.zh: 现在有人指控，由于这些因素，在这个过程中可能遗漏了一些事情。

sentences.en: We have to wait and see.
sentences.zh: 我们必须拭目以待。

sentences.en: So it sounds like it's not really a question of whether the school failed to follow the process.
sentences.zh: 所以听起来这并不是学校是否未能遵循程序的问题。

sentences.en: It sounds like it's more of a question of whether the process itself is adequate.
sentences.zh: 听起来更多的是关于程序本身是否充分的问题。

sentences.en: Yeah, and it's a really good point because the school did follow the process.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一个非常好的观点，因为学校确实遵循了程序。

sentences.en: We have 1,100 pages we've reviewed that show the school for hours and hours following the process.
sentences.zh: 我们查阅了1100页的文件，显示学校花了数小时遵循该程序。

sentences.en: The question is, does the process work?
sentences.zh: 问题是，这个程序有效吗？

sentences.en: And I sort of wonder to that point if that is the thing sparking so much outrage at Cornell and frankly, sort of around the country.
sentences.zh: 我有点好奇，这一点是否就是引发康奈尔大学乃至全国范围内如此多愤怒的原因。

sentences.en: Rachel, I don't know if that's the thing that's sparking so much outrage.
sentences.zh: 瑞秋，我不知道那是否是引发如此多愤怒的原因。

sentences.en: I think there's a lot of outrage in general.
sentences.zh: 我认为普遍存在很多愤怒。

sentences.en: I think the fact that Jane Doe is very familiar as an image to anyone who's ever been a woman who's gone to college, like 26% of women who go to college go on to say that
sentences.zh: 我认为简·多伊这个形象对于任何上过大学的女性来说都非常熟悉，比如26%上大学的女性后来表示

sentences.en: they've been raped or assaulted at some point.
sentences.zh: 她们在某个时候被强奸或侵犯过。

sentences.en: This is a story that continues to feel like it keeps happening.
sentences.zh: 这是一个让人感觉不断在发生的故事。

sentences.en: And much of the outrage that at least we're seeing in our inboxes here as reporters as we report on this is from people who feel frustrated that there were bits of her story
sentences.zh: 我们作为记者在报道此事时，在收件箱中看到的许多愤怒，来自于那些感到沮丧的人，因为她故事中的一些片段

sentences.en: that didn't seem to get to the people who were in the position to do something about it to help her.
sentences.zh: 似乎没有传达到那些有能力采取行动帮助她的人那里。

sentences.en: It also feels like this entire story is a bit of a Rorschach test, Debra, because I can imagine
sentences.zh: 黛布拉，这整个故事感觉也有点像罗夏墨迹测验，因为我可以想象

sentences.en: that there are people who are going to look at Jane Doe's story, look at these text messages and see a young woman who is so desperate to feel okay.
sentences.zh: 有些人会看着简·多伊的故事，看着这些短信，看到一个渴望感觉良好的年轻女性。

sentences.en: But I think that there are a lot of people who will look at all that same information and think to themselves, this is a woman who only accused
sentences.zh: 但我认为有很多人会看着同样的信息，心里想，这是一个女人，她之所以指控

sentences.en: these men of rape because she was being called a slut and a whore and she was trying to salvage her reputation.
sentences.zh: 这些男人强奸，是因为她被骂作荡妇和妓女，她试图挽回自己的名声。

sentences.en: Yeah, this is about as messy as it gets.
sentences.zh: 是的，这事儿乱得不能再乱了。

sentences.en: And we can see from these documents that even she was confused.
sentences.zh: 我们可以从这些文件中看到，连她自己都很困惑。

sentences.en: This is the opposite of clear cut.
sentences.zh: 这与黑白分明恰恰相反。

sentences.en: And the men who were accused, they also say this is unfair.
sentences.zh: 而被指控的男性也说这不公平。

sentences.en: And this is a system that didn't work for us either.
sentences.zh: 这是一个对我们也不起作用的系统。

sentences.en: We haven't been charged with anything criminally.
sentences.zh: 我们没有受到任何刑事指控。

sentences.en: Our version of events that they all say in these investigations is that they felt that everything was consensual.
sentences.zh: 他们在这些调查中都说，他们的事件版本是他们觉得一切都是自愿的。

sentences.en: Their lives have also been upended by this.
sentences.zh: 他们的生活也因此被颠覆了。

sentences.en: And whether you think that's fair or not depends a lot on your mindset before you even learn about this story.
sentences.zh: 至于你认为这是否公平，很大程度上取决于你在了解这个故事之前的心态。

sentences.en: The bottom line is we don't have a system with Title IX or in this country that really accounts for
sentences.zh: 底线是，我们没有一个第九条程序或在这个国家里真正能解释清楚的系统，

sentences.en: the messiness that is many, many cases of sexual assault, particularly on campus, particularly with
sentences.zh: 无法处理许多性侵犯案件的混乱，特别是在校园里，特别是在

sentences.en: Greek life, particularly when drugs and alcohol are involved.
sentences.zh: 兄弟会生活中，特别是在涉及毒品和酒精时。

sentences.en: What we know is that she made her statement to police and then she filed this lawsuit.
sentences.zh: 我们所知道的是，她向警方陈述了情况，然后提起了诉讼。

sentences.en: She has made a very strong allegation.
sentences.zh: 她提出了非常强烈的指控。

sentences.en: The criminal case is live again.
sentences.zh: 刑事案件再次启动了。

sentences.en: She is no longer in school.
sentences.zh: 她已经不在学校了。

sentences.en: And the question now, as the saga continues to play out, is really going to be whether all of this, all the conversation, all
sentences.zh: 随着事态的继续发展，现在的问题真正将是，这一切，所有的对话，所有的

sentences.en: the takes, all the opinions, whether this prompts any kind of reconsideration of how we view sexual
sentences.zh: 观点，所有的看法，是否会促使我们重新审视我们看待性

sentences.en: assault, how we view campus life in America, how we view the fraternity system, Greek life, the Title IX process, all of it.
sentences.zh: 侵犯的方式，我们看待美国校园生活的方式，我们看待兄弟会系统、希腊生活、第九条程序的方式，所有这些。

sentences.en: We don't know what's going to happen, but we do know that this case is making a lot of people pay attention.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道会发生什么，但我们确实知道这个案件让很多人开始关注。

sentences.en: Debra Kamen, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 黛布拉·卡门，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: Governor Kathy Hochul named the New York Attorney General Letitia James as a special prosecutor to investigate Jane Doe's allegations that she was raped at Cornell.
sentences.zh: 州长凯西·霍楚尔任命纽约州总检察长莱蒂西亚·詹姆斯为特别检察官，调查简·多伊关于她在康奈尔大学被强奸的指控。

sentences.en: In a statement on Thursday,
sentences.zh: 在周四的一份声明中，

sentences.zh: 霍楚尔表示，她将指派已经开始审查执法部门如何处理该索赔的詹姆斯，负责监督汤普金斯县的调查。

sentences.zh: 死囚克里斯塔·派克在田纳西州试图通过注射死刑处决她失败一天后，处于危急状态并正在接受医疗护理，她的律师
